memories.content: The user leads volunteers at Cedar Observatory. The arrangement was initially Saturday mornings, but Saturday is no longer available; Sunday mornings are now confirmed as the current schedule. Weekday evenings remain unavailable because of choir.

For the telescope restoration, the user ordered a brass focusing knob that fits the 1978 instrument. The club decided to retain the telescope's original blue finish rather than repaint it black, to preserve its history.
The user's cousin Ivo is joining the spring train trip. They chose May instead of April so the coastal line will be running.
